description: Explore underground labyrinths in search of untold fortune in Microsoft Treasure Hunt!  Classic Puzzle Gaming with Exciting New Features Microsoft Treasure Hunt builds on Microsoft Minesweeper for Windows Adventure mode experience. Mark suspicious terrain and plan your moves carefully to uncover tools, weapons, and even hidden bonus levels filled with loot. Using the gold you collect, purchase supplies, and permanent upgrades for your journey deep underground.  Exhilarating Adventure Intrepid treasure hunters will amass astonishing riches, but watch out! It will take all your wits to...
